title: “thegentlemanpervert” producing AI CSAM is a NJ prosecutor, say cops
gist: New Jersey deputy attorney general Brian Richard Fitzgerald was arrested on felony charges for allegedly using AI to turn social-media photos of real minors into sexualized images shared via Discord. The case, traced via an NCMEC tip and IP/subscriber records, reflects the DOJ's stance since 2024 that AI-generated CSAM is still CSAM.
